hero.lead: A nation of 35.6 million where a $20 billion gas project has restarted, and where nearly two in three citizens live below the national poverty line.

capital.heading: 21 instruments. Two gas projects, and grants for power, roads, schools, health, water and safety nets.

register.name: PURE Rural Mozambique Climate Project (FP290)
register.detail: Approved 28 March 2026 · Grant · Under implementation to 2033 · Total value $47.1 million
register.note: 66,200 people directly, 52% of them women
register.text: A Green Climate Fund grant through Enabel for climate resilience in rural Mozambique, reaching 158,800 more people indirectly. It protects rural water, food and livelihoods.

register.name: Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience Project
register.detail: Approved 26 June 2025 · IDA grant
register.note: Health workers, medicines, surveillance and laboratories
register.text: Recruits, trains and keeps health workers in high-risk areas, makes the purchase of medicines faster and more transparent, strengthens disease surveillance and laboratories, and builds climate-adapted health facilities. It is the health standard.

register.name: Human Development Integrated Project (INTEGRA)
register.detail: Approved 20 June 2025 · IDA grant · First phase · Five years, to 2030
register.note: Schools as hubs, in 20 of the most vulnerable districts
register.text: Makes schools hubs for learning, school meals, basic health care and social protection, in climate-resilient, connected and safe buildings. It reaches education, food and health for school-age children and their families.

register.name: Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation (ASCENT)
register.detail: Approved 21 March 2025 · IDA grant · Plus $31 million from the Mozambique Energy for All Multi-Donor Trust Fund
register.note: Electricity for nearly one million people
register.text: Brings new electricity access to nearly one million people, better cooking to 90,000 and power to 68 schools, clinics and other public facilities. Energy sets Coverage in Mozambique, where 8% cook with clean fuels and technology.
by: Mozambique Energy for All Multi-Donor Trust Fund

register.name: Linking climate adaptation and social protection (SAP042)
register.detail: Approved 18 July 2024 · Grant · Under implementation to 2029 · Total value $28.3 million
register.note: 975,000 people with increased resilience
register.text: A Green Climate Fund grant through Save the Children Australia that links climate adaptation with social protection for rural people, for better food and nutrition security.

register.name: Capacity Building for Improved Gender-based Violence Response Project
register.detail: Approved 30 April 2024 · IDA grant
register.note: 2,196 service providers trained
register.text: Trains and equips 2,196 providers of services for survivors of gender-based violence and builds a digital system for case management and referrals.

register.name: District and Community Health Services
register.detail: Announced 29 February 2024 · IDA grant $100 million · GFF grant $15 million · Top-up of $63.7 million, June 2025
register.note: About 4.6 million people, 1.5 million of them under five
register.text: Strengthens health and nutrition services in 63 districts of 10 provinces. The top-up of June 2025 adds $8.7 million from IDA, $5 million from the GFF and $50 million from a trust fund backed by Canada, the United Kingdom and Ireland.

register.name: Second Institutions and Economic Transformation Development Policy Financing
register.detail: Approved 22 November 2023 · Development policy lending
register.note: Budget support for reforms
register.text: Budget support for reforms that strengthen budget institutions and the economy. Its amount and date rest on the World Bank project page, which has not opened in these reviews.

register.name: Urban Water Security Program
register.detail: Announced 28 September 2023 · IDA grant
register.note: Nearly 1.3 million people
register.text: Improves water supply services in selected cities of the Greater Maputo metropolitan area and the southern region. It is the water standard, in a nation where 27.5% have safely managed drinking water.

register.name: Access to Finance and Economic Opportunities Project (Mais Oportunidades)
register.detail: Approved 30 March 2023 · IDA credit · 2023 to 2029
register.note: Over 26,000 new jobs expected over six years
register.text: Creates Mozambique’s first national Credit Guarantee Fund and lines of credit, to mobilise up to $450 million of private loans to micro, small and medium enterprises. It is the livelihood standard.

register.name: Safer Roads for Economic Integration Project
register.detail: Approved 23 August 2022 · IDA grant · First phase of a programme of $850 million
register.note: 508 km of priority roads in Cabo Delgado, Sofala and Zambezia
register.text: Rehabilitates priority sections of the national road network. Improving the N1 corridor would benefit about 56% of the population, linking them to markets, schools and clinics.

register.name: Social Protection and Economic Resilience Project
register.detail: Approved 16 December 2021 · IDA grant · $41 million from a multi-donor trust fund
register.note: Cash support for the poorest families
register.text: Strengthens and expands social protection for the poorest families, families with children and women’s economic empowerment, with trust fund support from the United Kingdom, Sweden and the Netherlands.

register.name: Sustainable Energy and Broadband Access in Rural Mozambique (ProEnergia Plus)
register.detail: Approved 14 December 2021 · IDA grant $300 million · Sweden and Norway $38 million · ESMAP Clean Cooking Fund $5 million
register.note: Over 340,000 connections by August 2025, against a target of 500,000
register.text: Brings grid electricity to about 1.1 million people and broadband to at least 580,000 in rural areas.

register.name: Improving Learning and Empowering Girls in Mozambique
register.detail: Approved 26 March 2021 · IDA grant $160 million · Global Partnership for Education $139 million
register.note: One hundred new rural preschools (Escolinhas)
register.text: Builds preschools in rural areas with low schooling, improves reading in the first three grades, expands lower secondary schools and makes schools safer for girls. It is the education standard.

register.name: Resilient Investment for Socio-Economic Empowerment, Peace and Security (RISE-PS)
register.detail: Announced 16 July 2025 · Grant from the Transition Support Facility
register.note: 24,000 direct jobs; more than 100,000 people
register.text: An AfDB grant for Cabo Delgado province, with 60% of the jobs for people aged 18 to 35 and half for women. It reaches livelihoods in the province of the gas projects.

register.name: Namaacha–Boane Transmission Line
register.detail: Announced 21 May 2025 · ADF $33.2 million · Climate Action Window $10.4 million
register.note: Up to 332 GWh a year of wind power
register.text: Two new 43 km, 66 kV lines that carry power from the planned 120 MW Namaacha wind farm into the grid, with thousands of new connections expected for rural and underserved communities.

register.name: Mozambique LNG, direct loan
register.detail: Second amendment approved 13 March 2025 · Loan of 2019
register.note: Onshore LNG plant on the Afungi Peninsula
register.text: The U.S. Export-Import Bank board approved the second amendment of its 2019 direct loan of up to $4.7 billion for the construction of the onshore LNG plant and related offshore work.
by: Export-Import Bank of the United States

register.name: Central Eléctrica de Tetereane solar and storage, Cuamba
register.detail: Issued 5 March 2026 · MIGA guarantee, 20 years · Breach of contract cover
register.note: 18.75 MWp of solar and a 6.7 MWh battery in Niassa
register.text: MIGA guarantees Globeleq against breach of contract under its power purchase agreement with Electricidade de Moçambique, for a solar and battery plant in Cuamba. Power for a remote northern province reaches homes, clinics and schools.

register.name: Trade Finance Transaction Guarantee, Banco Comercial e de Investimentos
register.detail: Approved by the AfDB Group · Three years · Covers up to 100% of eligible transactions
register.note: Trade finance for small and medium-sized enterprises
register.text: A guarantee facility that lets international banks confirm BCI’s trade transactions, widening trade finance for small and medium-sized firms. The release carries no date.

register.name: Mozambique LNG
register.detail: Project financing concluded 2020 · About 30 lenders · Force majeure lifted 7 November 2025 · Full restart 29 January 2026 · First LNG expected 2029
register.note: Over 3,000 Mozambicans among more than 4,000 workers; contracts to Mozambican firms above $4 billion
register.text: A liquefied natural gas project in Cabo Delgado led by TotalEnergies (26.5%), with Mitsui, ENH, ONGC Videsh, Beas, BPRL and PTTEP, at 40% progress. The partners will add equity to replace the UK Export Finance and Atradius share, about 10% of external financing; up to 7,000 Mozambicans are expected to work on construction.

register.name: Coral North floating LNG
register.detail: Final investment decision 2 October 2025 · AfDB senior loan approved 14 January 2026 · Project cost expected above $7 billion
register.note: 3.6 million tonnes a year; more than $20 billion of fiscal revenue estimated
register.text: A floating LNG facility about 55 km off Cabo Delgado, led by Eni (50%) with CNPC, Kogas, ENH and XRG, for delivery in 2028. Part of its gas is reserved for clean cooking, domestic industry and power, the standard that sets Coverage.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The Gas
items.label: Mozambique LNG, first gas expected 2029
items.text: Restarted after the force majeure was lifted in November 2025.
items.alt: The Afungi LNG site in Cabo Delgado

items.name: The Zambezi
items.label: Renewable share of electricity output, 2021
items.text: Clean power that reaches 36.9% of citizens.
items.alt: The Cahora Bassa dam on the Zambezi

items.name: The Coast
items.label: Natural resource rents, share of GDP, 2021
items.text: A long Indian Ocean coast, rich in fisheries, ports and minerals.
items.alt: The Mozambican coast on the Indian Ocean

items.name: Terramar
items.text: A Maputo importer, distributor and wholesaler of frozen and chilled foods, with one of the largest freezer capacities in Mozambique, serving retailers and restaurants. Norfund invested US$6 million of equity in 2022, alongside US$12 million from Zebu Investment Partners.

items.name: Globeleq
items.text: A power company owned by British International Investment and Norfund, which runs the Central Eléctrica de Tetereane solar and battery plant in Cuamba, Niassa, under a power purchase agreement with Electricidade de Moçambique. MIGA guaranteed the agreement in March 2026.

items.name: Lenmed, Maputo Private Hospital
items.text: A 105-bed private hospital in Maputo, part of the Lenmed hospital group. IFC disclosed an equity investment of up to US$28 million in the group in 2022.

items.name: Vodafone M-PESA Mozambique
items.text: A mobile money service whose active registered users tripled from 1.9 million to 6 million between 2018 and 2022, and which paid about 9 billion meticais (US$142 million) in commissions to its agents in five years. IFC signed a cooperation agreement with it in 2024 to reach more people, including smallholder farmers.
